title: Online BBA in Digital Marketing from DSU Online | Know More
description: Master Digital Marketing with DSU Online BBA. Gain job-ready skills in SEO, SEM & Content Marketing through our UGC-entitled 3-year online degree. Enroll today!

blocks.x: Web Development & Optimization | e-Commerce | Search-Engine-Marketing (SEM) & PPC | Content Marketing | Analytics and Data-driven Marketing

This elective allows you to dive into the world of online marketing — mastering how brands, platforms, content and analytics come together to reach and influence customers in digital channels. It is unique because: It emphasises digital-first business strategies, not just traditional marketing. You will gain skills in web development & optimization, e-commerce, search-engine-marketing (SEM) & PPC, content marketing, analytics and data-driven marketing. It aligns with the growing demand for digital-marketing professionals across industries, making you job-ready in a rapidly expanding field.
Building high-performance websites with modern frameworks, responsive design, faster load times, and SEO-friendly architecture.
Designing and managing online stores, payment integrations, customer experience optimization, and sales funnel strategy.
Paid advertising campaigns using Google Ads, keyword bidding, audience targeting, and maximizing ROI through effective PPC strategies.
Creating compelling content, brand storytelling, copywriting, and distribution strategies to engage and convert audiences.
Using analytics tools to track performance, measure KPIs, interpret customer behavior, and make data-backed marketing decisions.
Strategic advisory across management and operations.

Support recruitment, performance management, employee engagement, training and development programmes, and align HR functions with business goals.
